fix_subject: Regression fix: ChatMessageToolCall id must be a string (#990)

evidence_quote: Regression fix: ChatMessageToolCall id must be a string

fix_subject: fix(models): don't mask malformed tool-call errors as truncation (#896)
what_broke: The new format_error template treated any finish_reason=tool_calls as truncation, so a malformed tool call got a misleading "response cut off" message instead of the real validation error.
evidence_quote: the real validation error (e.g. "Unknown tool 'shell'.") was replaced by a "your response was cut off" message and never shown to the model
replay_notes: Moderate: run mini at 640165a^ vs 640165a with a model that emits a wrong tool name or missing command and compare the retry message the model receives; deterministic with a scripted model.

evidence_quote: This avoids errors about allowed keys from mistral, for example (because of the timestamp key)
replay_notes: Needs a provider that rejects unknown message keys; can be checked offline by inspecting the request payload at each commit.
